item.title: Route: Black Magic Witch (5.9)
item.description:
Black Magic Witch is a long climb (a 60m rope works) from the ground. Begin with easy climbing on blocks to a ledge that is even with the ramp/ledge at the base of It’s Not Worth It. Then move up fun, featured rock crossing multiple horizontal cracks and seams. From a higher ledge, the cracks mostly disappear, and it’s delicate, textured face climbing (2 bolts here) to the anchors.


Colorado > Ft Collins > Red Feather Lakes > Boy Scout Rd Areas > W Elkhorn Creek > Dome with a View > W Face
Shared By: Erica Exline

item.title: Route: It’s Not Worth It (5.9)
item.description:
Follow (and at times climbs slightly to the left of) a wide, lichen-filled chimney that starts on the ramp/ledge just to the right of Egyptian Groove. It is dirty at the bottom, but it has surprisingly solid and fun climbing. We started on a very thin flake that sounds barely connected; be gentle. Gain a small roof using jugs, a sidepull, and good foot holsa. It shares an anchor with Egyptian Groove.


Colorado > Ft Collins > Red Feather Lakes > Boy Scout Rd Areas > W Elkhorn Creek > Dome with a View > W Face
Shared By: Erica Exline

item.title: Route: Egyptian Groove (5.6)
item.description:
Egyptian Groove is a good warm-up for the area and great for anyone breaking into leading trad. It has non-stop opportunities for gear, solid stances, and quality rock. It begins in an obvious, inviting hand crack.

item.title: Area: West Face
item.description:
West Face can be shady or sunny depending on time of day. There are lots of trees at the base, so you should be able to find some shade regardless. It has good rock with interesting features and movement. It doesn’t seem highly trafficked, especially compared to Grazing Allotment and other nearby areas - there is lots of lichen on some routes, and some also are potentially still cleaning up.


Colorado > Ft Collins > Red Feather Lakes > Boy Scout Rd Areas > W Elkhorn Creek > Dome with a View

item.title: Route: Fireball (5.13a/b)
item.description:
Fireball is a forgotten line from Derek Peavey and Ben Scott!

Start with the same two bolts as for Rapid Fire. At the second bolt, find your own bouldering sequence (V5/6ish) to get to Derek’s traverse bolt up and left into the start of Cannon Ball. Make a hard clip at bolt 3, and save some fitness for the deadpoint crux of Cannon Ball.

I believe it’s a better line than Rapid Fire because of the controversy of what holds can be used on that monstrosity. This is a more direct link-up line straight through the hardest part of Mineshaft Wall.



Colorado > Ft Collins > Poudre Canyon > Palace > Mineshaft Wall
Shared By: Justin Smestad DC

item.title: Route: Introvert (5.7 R)
item.description:
Introvert is a fun route with good exposure. This route offers nice crimps and great foot holds!

Start on the face in between 'Smooth Moves Dihedral' and 'Star Fish'. Climb your way up and to the right while using the obvious jugs until you reach the subtle crack. Work your way up the crack slightly until you are met with a solid jug that you will use to traverse up and to the left of the route. You will be met with good exposure once you have reached the slab section near the top.

The downclimb will be to the left once you have topped out if soloing.



Colorado > Ft Collins > Horsetooth Rese… > Dungeon

item.title: Route: Iron Lung (5.11+)
item.description:
This is steeper and better than it appears climbing on varied terrain.

It is a route that progresses route from easy to more challenging - a nice wave of effort.

It is 5.11+++-. Use the crux clip calculator to assess the added difficulty while clipping crux draw. The rock only provideth, and it was hollow choss in every reasonable spot for a crux bolt on the crux boulder problem. Clip super mega beef chain draw before mantel to a non-trivial but easy finish.

The Ship Sailed

Train Derailed

Now it's me and my Iron Lung .

item.title: Comment re: Community Service: Interesting route in this area. I agree with the 5...
item.description:
Interesting route in this area. I agree with the 5.8+ as the hardest move wasn’t any worse than that. It felt mentally harder than Titanic - 5.10- next door, though. It is a bit runout in some areas, has odd clipping, and then the bat cave. Throw in some actually fun movement (an interesting slab section, getting up over that roof was interesting, a touch scary, and fun), and the rope drag at the end and this route is tough to classify.



I’d recommend it on lead, but not toprope (due to the anchor placement), but I would say be careful of the bat cave. I saw some fresh guano - no bat, but I kept my hand clear of things. I wouldn’t put a new 5.8 leader on this, but I still enjoyed it myself….



There are two solid enough feeling bolts at the top, although the right hanger is spinning just a touch, and the previous third bolt (no hanger) is still just sticking out. While safe enough for now, it feels like some anchor love would be well deserved.
Colorado > Ft Collins > Poudre Canyon > Low Hanging Fru… > Main Wall > Community Service (5.8+)
